entries.prompt: Generate ONE clean production game sprite on true transparent background. Big teal eyes, orange high ponytail, ONE white bow, blue short-sleeve jersey with white collar and white side stripes, blue athletic shorts with white side stripes, white wristbands, white ankle socks, white-blue sneakers. Match the concept's cute compact proportions. Flat vivid colors one hard shadow tone, thick clean dark contours, no gradients or painted texture. FULL BODY, all hair and shoes visible, 10% transparent margins, no floor or cast shadow, no ball, no net, no text, no scene, no palette swatches, no duplicate characters. Square canvas. Facing RIGHT (three-quarter right view), ready idle volleyball stance: feet slightly apart, knees gently bent, torso mostly upright, forearms loosely raised in front of waist, alert small smile. NOT deep squat. The entire character about 75% canvas height, centered. This will be the master design for 7 additional animation frames.
